description: This file defines the Schedule class within the OrangeHRM project, responsible for managing scheduled tasks in the HRM system. It includes methods for adding, retrieving, setting, and filtering tasks based on due status, along with generating unique task IDs.

classes.name: Schedule
classes.description: Class responsible for managing scheduled tasks including adding, filtering, and generating unique task IDs within the HRM scheduling system.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor initializing the Schedule with Console and OutputInterface dependencies.

methods.name: add
methods.description: Adds a new task based on CommandInfo, with validation and unique ID generation.

methods.name: setTasks
methods.description: Replaces current tasks with a provided array of tasks, maintaining key association with task IDs.

methods.name: getDueTasks
methods.description: Filters and returns tasks that are due based on the provided timezone.

methods.name: generateUniqueId
methods.description: Generates a unique ID for a task based on command string, ensuring no ID conflicts within current tasks.
